projectDescription: Nestlyze is an AI buyer's agent for US homebuyers that delivers personalized home recommendations, transparent property valuations, and 6-expert deep-dive analysis reports.
keyFeatures: AI onboarding chat that builds a buyer profile in 2 minutes
24 personalized home recommendations with narrative explanations
6-agent deep property analysis (Financial, Market, Physical, Environmental, Neighborhood, Legal)
Nestimate: transparent glass-box property valuation with reasoning bullets
Side-by-side AI comparison of shortlisted homes
Interactive map with school, price, and commute heatmap layers
Report sharing and public library opt-in
School attendance boundary lookup accurate to the polygon
Credit-based pricing with free first analysis
publicApiSurface: POST /api/v1/analyze — submit address for deep analysis
POST /api/v1/nestimate/compute — compute Nestimate valuation for an address
POST /api/v1/compare — AI side-by-side comparison of 2-3 reports
GET /api/v1/listings/{id} — get listing details with enrichment
POST /api/v1/match/score — get profile match score for a property
POST /api/v1/translate — translate a report to another language
